study: V99 R44 direct hedge frontier II
objective: spend part of R30 excess historical return on a locally stronger and more persistent direct opposite-net BTC hedge, without adding a new signal family
grid_policy: 27 local predeclared combinations around the proven R30 frontier: hedge 0.40/0.50/0.60 x cooldown 72/96/120h x minimum net 0.05/0.10/0.20; dd trigger 6%, market level 1 and gross cap 1.9 fixed
disclosure: Historical research only. Direct-hedge conditions use causal shadow equity and market data known by close t, with target changes applied to the next-open replay. No real-order path is enabled. Any historical winner requires frozen forward paper.
